basis: Recorded 12 November 2026 from installed Stata 19 MP under version 17 with set processors 1: insheet of ZeroToHero/data/fulfillment_delays.csv, encode supplier_tier, generate(supplier_id), then nbreg delay_days i.expedited distance_km backlog_index weather_disruption i.supplier_id. The data are underdispersed, so alpha runs to zero. Stata stopped at lnalpha = -45.6741473701887 with e(V) zero for lnalpha; where the fit stops is arbitrary and is not compared.
command: nbreg delay_days i.expedited distance_km backlog_index weather_disruption i.supplier_id
